applies_why: This judge text addresses a collision over Matthew 1:20 by noting each side's chain-answer, so it performs the chain-against-chain assessment governed by K-C.
quote: D2 vs C1 (Matthew 1:20): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the conception agency as covenant presence in [DR3] and defender answered the physical source in the womb in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: 'weighs chain against chain by footing': the judge must assess the relative support of the competing chains, or merely noting that each side gave an answer is enough to call the link underdetermined.
why: The judge text calls the point underdetermined merely because each side answered, without weighing the competing chains by footing as K-C requires.
